definitions.explanation: A basket or container used to hold dirty clothes before washing or clean clothes after washing.

examples.japanese: {汚|よご}れた{服|ふく}を{洗濯籠|せんたくかご}に{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put dirty clothes in the laundry basket.

examples.japanese: {洗濯籠|せんたくかご}がいっぱいになったから、{洗濯|せんたく}しよう。
examples.english: The laundry basket is full, so let's do the laundry.

examples.japanese: {乾|かわ}いた{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{洗濯籠|せんたくかご}に{入|い}れて{部屋|へや}に{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: I put the dried laundry in the basket and carried it to the room.

notes:
VARIANTS:
・ランドリーバスケット (laundry basket - loanword)
・{洗濯|せんたく}かご (written with hiragana かご)

RELATED LAUNDRY ITEMS:
・{洗濯機|せんたくき} (washing machine)
・{乾燥機|かんそうき} (dryer)
・{洗濯|せんたく}ばさみ (clothespin)
・{物干|ものほ}し (drying rack)
・{洗剤|せんざい} (detergent)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{洗濯籠|せんたくかご}に{入|い}れる (to put in the laundry basket)
・{洗濯籠|せんたくかご}から{出|だ}す (to take out of the laundry basket)
